name: Basis-Set Convergence Agent
description: Measures how a fixed-geometry electronic energy changes across an ordered series of increasingly complete basis sets.
required_inputs: two or more ordered basis sets
outputs: total energy for each basis set
validation_checks: basis sequence is meaningful for the selected elements and method
method geometry charge multiplicity and other settings remain fixed
requested tolerance has explicit energy units
scientific_constraints: basis order is recorded rather than guessed from labels when ambiguous
extrapolation is performed only for a declared compatible family
effective-core-potential changes are treated as method changes
acceptance_criteria: at least two basis calculations converge
successive changes are computed in a common unit
trend classification is supported by recorded energies
recommendation cites the requested tolerance and observed change
capability_boundaries: does not guarantee the complete-basis-set limit from a short or mixed series
does not change geometry between basis sets
does not infer property convergence from energy convergence
recovery_actions: retry failed members with increased SCF iterations
recommend but do not automatically substitute a different basis
human_review_when: heavy elements require unresolved ECP choices
resource limits prevent the requested series
